report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-21 at 10:00 IST (04:30 UTC), the morning redemption payout batch PB-1021-AM (2,412 queued payouts) was initiated by job-scheduler but failed to process any transactions, leaving 2,412 users waiting for their redemption proceeds. Payout-service metrics and dashboards timed out because all queries and transactions against the 'payout_instructions' table were blocked by an uncompleted schema migration (CHG-48223 / migration 0142) executing an ALTER TABLE with a non-null default value that acquired an AccessExclusiveLock on the table four minutes prior to the batch run.
report.rootCauseStatement: Schema migration 0142 (change CHG-48223) initiated at 04:25:56 UTC executed 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''' under database process PID 48213. This DDL statement held an exclusive table lock on 'payout_instructions' for over 136 minutes, blocking payout-service worker processes seeking RowExclusiveLock and causing all redemption payout operations and datastore queries to hang indefinitely.

hypotheses.cause: Schema migration 0142 on primary database executed an ALTER TABLE on 'payout_instructions' with a NOT NULL DEFAULT clause, acquiring an AccessExclusiveLock that blocked payout-service read/write transactions for the 10:00 IST redemption batch and caused dashboard queries to time out.
hypotheses.rationale: Direct database engine logs show process 48213 running the ALTER TABLE migration continuously for over 136 minutes while repeatedly blocking database worker processes waiting for RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions. payout-service logs concurrently show batch PB-1021-AM waiting for table locks exceeding 8,016 seconds with 0 payouts sent.

hypotheses.cause: Upstream partner bank APIs degraded or returned errors, causing bank-connector and payout-service calls to stall.
hypotheses.rationale: bank-connector request rate remained steady at ~17.9 req/s, error rate remained baseline at ~0.51%, and timeouts remained negligible at ~0.44/min. Zero payouts reached partner banks because payout-service was blocked on local database locks prior to dispatching outbound calls.

facts.statement: An infrastructure schema migration CHG-48223 was initiated on service 'database' by deploy-bot at 2026-10-21T04:26:00.000Z to run migration 0142 ('ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref') and remained in_progress throughout the incident window.

Database logs confirm that process PID 48213 started running 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''' around 04:25:56 UTC and remained active for over 136 minutes.

Multiple database processes (such as 51765, 51716, 51181, 51988) logged lock wait warnings after 1000.0 ms waiting for RowExclusiveLock on relation payout_instructions, directly blocked by process PID 48213.
job-scheduler triggered job payout-batch-am at 2026-10-21T04:30:00.000Z and payout-service queued 2,412 redemptions for batch PB-1021-AM at 2026-10-21T04:30:06.000Z.

payout-service logged repeated warnings and errors beginning at 2026-10-21T04:32:38.487Z stating that batch PB-1021-AM was waiting for a lock on payout_instructions, accumulating over 8,016 seconds of wait time by 06:43:23 UTC with 0 payouts sent.
bank-connector maintained normal traffic and baseline error rates (~0.51%) and timeout counts (~0.44/min) across the entire 04:00 to 06:45 UTC observation window.

inferences.statement: The DDL migration table lock blocked payout-service database transactions attempting to write or read payout instructions, directly halting the 10:00 IST batch from dispatching bank transfer requests.

Payout monitoring dashboards failed to load because database queries against payout_instructions queued behind the exclusive table lock held by PID 48213 and timed out past the configured datastore thresholds.

assumptions.statement: Adding a column with a default value on this large table caused a table rewrite or prolonged metadata catalog lock due to lack of lock timeout configuration on the migration script.

recommendedActions.action: Terminate the blocking migration process PID 48213 on the primary database (or cancel statement) to release the AccessExclusiveLock on payout_instructions.
recommendedActions.rationale: Terminating the hung migration query will immediately release lock contention, allowing payout-service worker threads to acquire locks and execute pending transactions.
recommendedActions.verification: Check pg_stat_activity / database logs to confirm PID 48213 is no longer active and verify payout-service logs stop reporting lock wait warnings.

recommendedActions.action: Trigger or restart redemption payout batch PB-1021-AM in payout-service to dispatch the 2,412 pending user redemptions.
recommendedActions.rationale: The queued redemptions have remained stalled at 0 sent since 10:00 IST.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor payout-service logs and bank-connector request rates to verify payout initiation logs and confirmation callbacks.

recommendedActions.action: Refactor migration 0142 to add nullable columns without default values or use safe concurrent migration patterns with explicit lock_timeout parameters.
recommendedActions.rationale: Running ALTER TABLE with NOT NULL DEFAULT on active high-volume transactional tables acquires exclusive locks and rewrites tables, stalling production traffic.
recommendedActions.verification: Test migration 0142 in staging with lock_timeout set to 2s and verify zero blocking during simulated workload.

recommendedActions.action: Enforce change freeze policies preventing DDL migrations during scheduled payout processing windows (specifically around 10:00 and 14:00 IST).
recommendedActions.rationale: Scheduling DDL migrations minutes before scheduled batch operations introduces high operational risk.
